prompt: A very long reply (about 1,700 characters) hit the 30-second timeout on the text-to-speech request and failed the whole turn with no audio at all. Nothing limits how much text we send to speech synthesis, and the timeout is a hard-coded number. Cap the text sent to speech at a configurable length, 700 characters by default, trimming at the last sentence boundary so the reply ends on a complete thought, and fall back to an ellipsis when no boundary is late enough to keep the reply substantial. The cap must be hard, ellipsis included. Make the speech-to-text and text-to-speech timeouts configurable too, with text-to-speech defaulting to 45 seconds and speech-to-text to 30.
